player_prompt.intro:
Mukusewera {difficulty} RushHour puzzle. Sukusula magalimoto kuti muweze kusuntha galimoto lalikulu [X] ndi kulituma kutoka kumanja.
Zochita: [A+], [B-], ndiponso.  (+ = patsogolo, - = mbuyo).

invalid_move.wrong_format: Njira yosonyeza si sazi. Tumia fomu [A+] / [B-].

game_message.solved: Galimoto yofiira ikupita kutali! Mwathetsa vutoli.
